entry.title: FTC Action Results in Court Issuing Temporary Restraining Order Halting Phantom Debt Collection Operation
entry.summary: Complaint alleges scheme operators used false threats to collect over $20 million in often-fictitious debts from consumers At the Federal Trade Commission’s request, a federal court has temporarily halted and frozen the assets of a debt collection operation that allegedly used deceptive and unlawful tactics to pressure consumers into paying debts that they frequently did not owe. View Press Release

entry.title: FTC Secures Settlement with Stream Auto Outlet, Advancing Price Transparency for Auto-Buying Consumers
entry.summary: The Federal Trade Commission announced an agreement today with Stream Auto Outlet, resolving claims that the Long Island, New York-based dealership group deceived consumers by advertising prices far lower than what consumers ultimately had to pay.View Press Release

entry.title: Five States Join FTC Lawsuit Alleging Hims and Hers Engaged in Deceptive and Unlawful Privacy Practices
entry.summary: The Federal Trade Commission filed an amended complaint adding five states as co-plaintiffs in its lawsuit alleging that telehealth provider Hims and Hers shared consumers’ sensitive health information with third-party advertising platforms, despite claiming its services maintain consumers’ privacy, and it deceived users about its billing and cancellation practices.View Press Release

entry.title: FTC and 17 States Secure $63 Million Settlement with Family Dollar Stores in Price Transparency Win for Consumers
entry.summary: Family Dollar has generated millions of dollars by charging more at the register than the prices it advertises, the FTC and states allege Family Dollar will pay $63 million to settle Federal Trade Commission and state allegations that the company routinely charged customers more at the register than the prices displayed on shelves, price tags and advertisements, costing consumers millions of dollars. View Press Release

entry.title: FTC Sues to Block Veterinary Supplies Distributor Covetrus’s $3.5 Billion Acquisition of Rival MWI
entry.summary: FTC alleges that combining the two biggest distributors of veterinary products and services will drive up costs and lead to higher prices for veterinary clinics and pet owners The Federal Trade Commission sued today to block Covetrus Inc. and its owners, Clayton, Dubilier & Rice LLC and TPG Inc., from acquiring its closest competitor, MWI Veterinary Supply Inc., for $3.5 billion from MWI’s parent, Cencora Inc.View Press Release

entry.title: FTC Takes Enforcement Action Against Safety-Harness Manufacturer for Allegedly False Made in the USA Claims
entry.summary: FTC’s proposed order requires the company to stop making deceptive claims and pay a monetary judgment The Federal Trade Commission is taking action against Elk River Inc., an Alabama-based manufacturer of safety harnesses and other fall protection equipment for workers, for falsely claiming that its harnesses are “Made in USA.”View Press Release

entry.title: Ten Additional States Join FTC Lawsuit Alleging Dollar General Charged Consumers More than Advertised for Many Products
entry.summary: The Federal Trade Commission filed an amended complaint adding ten states as co-plaintiffs in a lawsuit alleging that Dollar General Corporation engaged in long-running deceptive pricing practices by routinely charging customers more at the register than the prices displayed on shelves, price tags and advertisements, costing consumers millions of dollars. View Press Release

entry.title: SHEIN to Pay $100 Million Over Allegations of Deceptive and Unfair Practices
entry.summary: FTC alleges SHEIN generated billions while engaging in unfair customer service practices and deceiving millions of American consumers about its products, suppliers and consumer reviews SHEIN will pay $100 million in consumer redress to settle Federal Trade Commission allegations that the fast-fashion retailer made it unreasonably difficult for consumers to resolve purchase issues, failed to keep its shipping promises, suppressed negative reviews and made deceptive supply chain and cotton-origin

entry.title: FTC Finalizes Order Resolving Antitrust Concerns Stemming from Beretta, Ruger Stock Purchase Deal
entry.summary: The Federal Trade Commission has finalized an order resolving antitrust concerns related to a stock purchase agreement between two of the largest firearm manufacturers, Beretta Holding S.A. and Sturm, Ruger & Co. Inc., by prohibiting anticompetitive entanglements between the two companies.View Press Release

entry.title: FTC Grants In Part and Denies In Part Northrop Grumman Petition to Set Aside Order
entry.summary: The modifications to the 2018 order would limit its scope to cover only the sale of large solid rocket motors The Federal Trade Commission today modified a 2018 order related to Northrop Grumman Corporation’s acquisition of aerospace and defense contractor Orbital ATK, narrowing the order’s scope to apply only to missile competitions involving large solid rocket motors (SRMs).View Press Release
